projects.title: Resume to Cover Letter generator
description: Fine-tuning LLaMA-3 to generate personalized, role-specific cover letters by aligning resume skills and projects with job descriptions.
Evaluated open-source (Mistral, Qwen) and commercial LLMs (Gemini, GPT), identifying gaps in contextual personalization and scope for domain-specific fine-tuning.

projects.title: BMSIT Faculty App
description: Developing a cross-platform meeting management app using Kotlin, React and Firebase for scheduling, attendance tracking and meeting records.
Integrated FireStore, Cloud functions and FastAPI backend with Google's Speech-to-Text API for transcription and an AI model for meeting summarizations.

research.title: Research Paper: Early Detection of Neonatal Sepsis using Federated Learning
description: Built a Transformer-based Federated Learning model enabling hospitals to collaboratively train on EHRs without sharing patient data, ensuring HIPAA & GDPR compliance.

research.title: Book Chapter : Medical Image Analysis using Deep Learning (Co-author)
description: Co-authored a chapter for an upcoming book under the guidance of Dr Niranjanamurthy .
Focused on applying deep learning models for segmentation and classification of medical imagery.

research.title: Research Paper (In Progress): AI and Big Data Analytics in Congenital Heart Disease
description: Experimenting with various models and available datasets for improved diagnosis and treatment prediction.
